name: Beach Walk Residence Phase 2 By Imtiaz

overview: Imtiaz Developments is excited to announce the debut of Beach Walk Residence Phase 2 By Imtiaz, a stunning addition to the Dubai Islands skyline. This eight-story masterpiece exemplifies contemporary beauty and architectural genius. Nestled among the tranquil waves of the Arabian Gulf, Beach Walk Residence Phase 2 By Imtiaz provides its occupants with a never-ending island vacation experience.
